data.explanation: This language school needs you to take a short placement test before they can enrol you in the B1 evening course. Use the link they sent by e-mail to book a test slot before the deadline shown; spots in the course are capped at sixteen students, so booking early helps secure a place. If you miss the deadline, contact the course office (Kursbüro) to check whether a slot is still available.
